_comment: The windswept country, the yardangs. Said of the land, or alone, it is the landform it always was; said of the
Age (`windswept age`) it is the landform, and now and then the wind that carved it still blowing -- a gale, or
more rarely a blizzard or a tornado (Jonah). Authored over the landform's derived word to say the second; the first is that
